_comment: First-party My Nether's Delight compat on the NETHER FOREST seed (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). A crimson-look variant with a patch of MND's powdery cane among the crimson roots/fungi. REGRESSION FIX (SIGNOFFPLAN B1b): the `patch_powdery_cane` configured feature won't place through Skyseed's direct call, so we plant the BonemealableBlock `mynethersdelight:powdery_cane` as a `ground` crop with a `grow` range; GenerationJob.growCrops bonemeals each to a varied stage. Crimson nylium is valid soil (`powdery_cannon_plantable_on` includes #minecraft:nylium). The crimson-fungus tree stays a feature. Inert without MND. ⚠ IN-GAME VERIFY + tune.
